instruction: Below the line: By numbering at least 12 of these boxes in the order of your choice (with number 1 as your first choice).
notes: Below-the-line ballots only, as marked. Not a full count of the election: above-the-line votes are left out. AEC formal preferences file aec-senate-formalpreferences-27966-NT.zip: 103,617 formal ballot papers, 10,748 below the line and 92,869 above the line. Cleanup follows the Commonwealth Electoral Act 1918 (see data/ausenate/README.md): a below-the-line vote numbering at least 1 to 6 is used as marked, up to the first missing or repeated number; otherwise the above-the-line marks are used the same way. blank_ballots holds all 3,290 informal ballots from the AEC (not only blank ones). Official winners in order of election, from SenateSenatorsElectedDownload. The Senate count uses the weighted inclusive Gregory method with bulk exclusions.
